versions.content: When providing a new Global Time tuple to the StbM via StbM_BusSetGlobal Time() , EthTSyn shall set the SYNC_TO_GATEWAY bit in timeBaseStatus (structure member, which is referenced by the parameter timeStampPt r) , according to the SGW value (refer to [PRS_TS_00156] ). The remaining status bits shall be set to 0.

When providing a new Global Time tuple to the StbM via StbM_BusSetGlobalTime , EthTSyn shall set the SYNC_TO_GATEWAY bit in time BaseStatus (structure member, which is referenced by the parameter timeStampPtr), according to the SGW value (refer to [PRS_TS_00156]). The remaining status bits shall be set to 0.
